name: Mary Morstan's Death
description: Mary Morstan dies during the period of Holmes's apparent death — between The Final Problem (May 1891) and The Empty House (April 1894). Watson refers to "my own sad bereavement" in the opening of The Empty House but provides no details, and the event is never directly depicted. Her death restores Watson to his bachelor state and explains his return to shared lodgings at 221B Baker Street upon Holmes's reappearance. Sherlockian scholarship has speculated extensively about cause and date; the canon offers nothing.
